name: Eaagads Limited
source: Eaagads Limited annual report and financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026 (Deloitte and Touche LLP, unqualified opinion), statement of financial position page 34 and statement of cash flows page 36, KShs thousands stored in absolute Kenya shillings: non-current assets 1,484,287; current assets 276,239; total assets 1,760,526; total equity 1,443,567; non-current liabilities 252,347; current liabilities 64,612; cash and bank balances 43,925; biological assets 122,562; inventories 9,159; trade and other receivables 100,593; property plant and equipment 1,484,074; right of use asset 213; share capital 40,196; revaluation reserve 1,175,358; retained earnings 228,013. CRON 20261117: FY2026 column written and total equity replaces the rounded 1,444,000,000 with the printed 1,443,567. Total liabilities 316,959 is the sum of the two printed liability subtotals. Identity: non-current plus current assets equals total assets, and equity plus non-current plus current liabilities equals the same, both exactly. CRON 20261117 cash flow: FY2026 column added (operating 43,696; capital expenditure 146; investing 146 used; financing 30,869 used; net increase 12,681; opening 31,578; exchange effect 334; closing 43,925) and the FY2025 net increase corrected from 17,033 to the printed 16,503, which is what makes opening 14,545 plus the net increase plus the 530 exchange effect equal the printed closing 31,578. Free Cash Flow is operating cash flow less capital expenditure.
source_note: Kshs'000 x 1,000 to absolute KES. Investing activities FY2022 printed as a dash (nil).
